title: Knotty Sweet Egyptian Kimchi Flatbread
description: A sweet and gooey Egyptian dish featuring all purpose flour and ferment-kimchi, perfect for meal prep. It is a shojin-friendly recipe, making it suitable for vegetarians and vegans.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the olive oil, yeast, and warm water to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large circle or rectangle.
Spread the ferment-kimchi and dates over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling to form a knotty shape.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
